data.description:
the task family seems to be completely different than anything we've seen before. the questions implied by the searches in september are like:
in the baltimore sun, what was reported about billy carter in oct 1 1980
what did southport visitor report about annie besant on june 12 1906
... more tasks that seem to match a named publication + named person + named date
These don't seem to be agents directed by individual users because there are several of these tuples asked repeatedly over multiple days (the annie besant one was the most, and I also found urlquery usage targeted towards the same info on other newspaper archiving tools such as britishnewspaperarchive.co.uk → 36 reports, trove.nla.gov.au → 2, findmypast.co.uk → 45, findmypast.com → 8, chroniclingamerica.loc.gov. The reason this is interesting to me is that perhaps this is some non openai model doing an internal benchmark that oai doesn't run. A discounting fact against that though is that this still uses urlquery. (edited)
data.summary: James and I: newspapers.com and other newspaper archives hit with questions that are not associated with a public benchmark, not seen before in oai activity
